none: PAS FindID 931954: Roman silver finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Description. Treasure reference 2018 T1052: an incomplete Roman silver finger ring, Henig Type VIII. The bezel is circular, worn and no decoration or inscription is visible. The shoulders are triangular and slope away from the bezel. Each shoulder is decorated with a pair of rows comprising punched dots. Discussion.
